tests.scope: bounded synthetic, model initialization and isolated persistence tests; no complete robot attempts

repair.noise_matrix: positive Gauss-Legendre noise-factor integral, no clipping or shrink

state_error_validation.scope: six held-out signal suffixes plus four already-seen archive regressions; startup and contact peaks retained
state_error_validation.startup_caveat: CA valid-startup peak is larger than CV; initial covariance consumes the budget, so low settled RMS is not a peak guarantee
state_error_validation.ideal_contact_caveat: CA has larger ideal contact peak/NIS than CV; no uniform improvement claim

qualification.uncertainty_calibration_scope: development-only density calibration; empirical marginal coverage and NIS/NEES on correlated signals, no joint/all-time confidence certificate
